reason: I love that it's a one-time pass with no sneaky auto-renewal, but on a $15k student budget in a normal week I don't really need to pay $4.99 when I can join /arena rooms for free and my Discord group already swaps summarized PDFs.
objection: Buying a 7-day pass during a normal week just wastes the timer before exams hit, and I'm skeptical a 60-second AI generator won't mangle messy quantitative formulas even if it quotes the slides verbatim.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the free starter deck nail a dense quantitative slide deck during actual midterm week, or having cram credits that don't start a 7-day expiration clock until I activate them.
